name: Sex Teacher
source:
This story is about two young senior students. Erika is writing her thesis about sex, but she has never done it! Her friend Aaron rushes to help her!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2203770]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一个关于两名大四学生的故事。艾丽卡正在撰写一篇以性为主题的毕业论文，可她本人却毫无实战经验！她的好友亚伦当即自告奋勇赶来帮她解围！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2203770]Steam[/url]]
